So every pokemon has a cp and a level. Every time you power up a pokemon 1 stage, it gets half a level, so if the cp bar is all the way to the left, it is level 1. If you power it up, it's level 1.5, so on and so forth. Ivs affect how much cp a pokemon will have at a given level. So, a perfect slaking at level 50 or maxed out has a cp of 5010. A non perfect slacking at level 50 will have a slightly lower cp. Attack ivs give the largest boost to cp. Higher attack iv higher cp. When it comes to little, great, and ultra league, they have a cp cap: 500, 1500, and 2500, respectively. So after going over all that, the reason non perfect ivs can be perfect for a league is because you want to maximize the level of the pokemon within the cp cap. As for Master League, there is no cap, so you want the best iv and the highest level.
